_comment: MCP servers the system expects. Plugin servers (figma, playwright, chrome-devtools) arrive with their plugins in settings.template.json and need no step here. The user-scope servers below are offered by installer/install-claude-layer.py --mcp NAME (or --mcp all): it runs `claude mcp add --scope user` with the URL only. Every one signs in with the teammate's own account through OAuth on first use; no token is ever written by the installer.

plugin_servers.name: figma
plugin_servers.use: read and write Figma files (figma-craft, design agents)

plugin_servers.name: playwright
plugin_servers.use: browser captures and checks at 390 and 320

servers.name: magnific
servers.use: image, video and audio generation (nano-banana-pro routes through imagen-nano-banana-2 here)

servers.name: higgsfield
servers.use: Higgsfield generation for the vault higgsfield-* skills; the owner adds it per project, so it is opt-in
